page.overview:
Who is Baby Jake?

Jake, also known as Baby Jake is the version of Jake from the Baby World timeline who makes his first appearance in "The Winter King".

He greatly resembles his counterpart when he was an infant. The difference is that he wears a onesie with the letter J.

He first appears in "The Winter King", when Fionna, Cake, and Simon Petrikov visit his universe. He is seen with Finn as they play with Cake who soon brought them over to her friends. He watched as Finn got a hold of a rattle and hit Baby Cinnamon Bun in the head, causing him to cry.

He was seen jumping on Baby Lich in “The Bear and the Rose”, where he and Cinnamon Bun witnessed Huntress Wizard forms an avatar in the world. Both he and Cinnamon Bun cheered when she suddenly disappeared.
